name: Massmore_TCS34725
description: Dependency-free Arduino / ESP32 driver for the ams-OSRAM TCS34725 / TCS34727 RGBC color sensor (Massmore SKU-0067): atomic RGBC block read, blocking + non-blocking FSM API, DN40 lux / CCT with saturation detection, auto-range, dark / white calibration, RGB888 / HSV, interrupt + low-power wait, chip authenticity self-test. No dynamic allocation.
